$reason: A `<` in a block's condition, `@if (count() <limit())`: the tag scan reads `<limit())` as a tag running on to the next `>`, and the retry `<span>` after it, a stop a user lands on, vanishes into its attributes. The parsed tree holds the span as it is. A tag the tree holds nothing for outside an ICU case is no element and is read as such, so the false tag passes; the span is the tree's alone, and the tree's own count of its tags fails point 1. The tag scan used to refuse the false tag for the `[attr.tabindex]` it swallowed; prettier refuses the template as well, and this is the gate's own reason.
